description.narrative: The Program Development Objective of the DPL series is to support the Guatemalan Government in creating fiscal space and expanding opportunities for the most vulnerable segments of society.

The objective of the First Programmatic Development Policy Loan Project for Guatemala is to support the Guatemalan Government in creating fiscal space and expanding opportunities for the most vulnerable segments of society. This programmatic series of Development Policy Loans (DPLs) will support the Government's reform agenda in three areas: (i) strengthening tax administration and tax policy; (ii) enhancing the quality of public expenditure; and (iii) improving the coordination and management of social policy.
